display_long_description:
**Can you reach the top?**

Welcome to **Jank Jumpers, a co-op VR obby** that'll have you making death defying leaps to summit massive floating crags. Team up with friends and work together to discover the path up!
[media]


# Explore Hidden Routes
Each level brings new challenges: risky shortcuts, moving hazards, and momentum-based puzzles that reward creativity as much as precision. Discover hangout spots and more secrets along the way.
[media]


# The Jank Jump
Master the Jank Jump and soar to improbable heights and across impossible distances. It will take some practice...
[media]

# Reach the top
Make the climb and the golden idol will be waiting for you at the summit. Earn stars for each crag you complete.
[media]

Jump. Jank. Fall. Laugh — then do it all over again.

See you at the top.
